notes: New: emotes (number keys 1-9 in fights, quick chat like Pass it / Help / Switch in Hoops, your opponent sees them), key binds in Settings, a Suggest button for your ideas, pick your grade once (Global chat is split by grade), a bigger update alert, a nicer chat, and invite friends right from the private match screens. Join codes are now 4 digits. Online connects more reliably, even on networks that block the usual link. Online fights run at normal speed again. Hoops: defense gets the edge on rebounds and greens glow at the rim for everyone. Racer: save your tracks and build one together online. Announcements stay on screen until closed.
